explication: Bullet Physics SDK is a C++ engine for real-time collision detection and physics simulation, with CPU and optional OpenCL paths plus extensions such as soft bodies and character control. A principal workflow registers bodies and shapes, advances a simulation, and exposes collision/query results. The graph emphasizes components and relationships identified in the README and SOURCE INDEX; several runtime links are omitted because their implementation was not sampled.
